provenance: Derived from the pinned NIFC Meissonnier fils encoding, corrected against the exact local Paderewski Mazurka scan; source originals retained

verified_scope: written small-note chords and single grace notes
independent lower-staff voices and clef changes
corrections: Remove the converted first-edition C#5 ties in measures 18 and 22: Paderewski shows a phrase slur above E5 to C#5; the lower C#5 is reattacked on beat 3.
Retain the explicit grace chords D5/F5 and D4/F4 in measures 18 and 22 and the F5 grace attacks before F6 in measures 37 and 41; these were skipped by the former importer.
Add fermatas to both half-note closing chords in measure 24.
Add the scan dynamic levels f (1), p (9), ff (17), p (21), p (25), p (37), f (45), p (53), and Allegro ma non troppo/Poco piu vivo/rit./Tempo I words.
Preserve all 60 printed measures with no invented repeats; preserve independent bass voices, the shared A3 unison in measures 17/19/21/23 and the lower-staff clef changes in 44/45.
